summary: Grupo Supervielle S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its ordinary and extraordinary shareholders' meeting held on April 23, 2026. The filing details routine corporate governance matters: approval of financial statements for fiscal year 2025, appointment of shareholders to sign minutes, and consideration of board performance. No extraordinary transactions such as acquisitions, divestitures, or capital changes were announced. The meeting was conducted virtually per company bylaws with a quorum of 78.80% of capital. This is a standard periodic report of a foreign issuer, akin to a domestic 8-K for procedural items, lacking any event trigger for special-situations classification.
